Builder

Operator Uplift.
A stake in keeping your word.

Choose a commitment, stake money, and submit photo or app proof. AI review provides one verification signal. Keep your commitment and your stake comes back. Miss it and 96% of your stake goes to the people who finished. I’m building the product and protocol on Solana, with the app live in the Solana Mobile Seeker dApp Store. Operator Uplift has 2,200+ accounts, separate from the waitlist.

Founder

Velocity Esports.
Bootstrapped from zero.

Founded May 17, 2014. I built partnerships with MLG and Quest Nutrition, and signed an MLG.tv contract at 14.

Sold it. Built the team.

$1M+ in door-to-door sales. $25k/month at peak. Trained and led a team of 5–10 reps.

Selected esports results

  • 1st · Apex Legends Microsoft Store LAN — Fatal Ambition roster
  • 1st · Halo Infinite CMG 4v4 #CHAMPS
  • 1st · Trolli Halo 4v4 qualifier for the $2,500 finals

Top 5 global seasonal rankings in Fortnite and Halo 5.

Three clothing brands

I started HappyHerbCo, Luhu Clothing, and SummerLyfe.

Recovery community leadership

Previously a House Leader and Assistant Men’s Director at the McShin Foundation. Certified peer-to-peer counselor in mental health and addiction. That work informs why I build around accountability.

Certifications on LinkedIn

Kept showing up.

After an initial rejection from The Residency, I joined Actioners and was later selected for The Residency.

  • Accepted into Empower Residency in Da Nang after an initial rejection.
  • Worked from Founders Inc for about 2.5 months after my program application was declined.
  • Accepted into the London Solana Hacker House. Attendance depends on visa approval and travel funding.
  • Accepted into CastleDAO / Superteam Ireland and selected for a Solana gaming hacker house in Ho Chi Minh City.

$50/month hosting + maintenance

A clear place to send people, with the content and setup to launch it. Send me your idea, links, and what you want visitors to do.

Website

A mobile-friendly website with clear sections, your work or offer, and a contact or booking link. We agree the page and content scope before the build.

Launch video

A short video introducing your site or offer, made from agreed product screens, footage, and brand assets. The format and length are agreed before production.

Hosting & domain setup

I connect your domain, set up hosting, and publish the site. Domain setup and initial registration are included for now. Ongoing hosting is covered by the $50/month hosting + maintenance plan; domain renewals are agreed before you incur them.

CMS

A simple content editor for the parts of the site you need to update. We agree which text, images, or posts you can edit before the build.

Hosting + maintenance — $50/month

Ongoing website hosting, small text and image updates, link checks, and fixes to the delivered site for $50/month. New pages, major redesigns, and extra features are quoted separately.

Social strategy

A practical launch plan covering your audience, key message, channels, and first posts. Ongoing posting and channel management are available as a separate service.

Website + launch: $100 one-time. Hosting + maintenance: $50/month. Initial domain registration and setup included for now. Scope, delivery date, and future domain renewals agreed before kickoff.
